name: China Merchants Energy Shipping Co., Ltd.
summary: China Merchants Energy Shipping Co., Ltd. delivers a wide array of energy and general maritime transportation services. Its business is segmented into four main areas: container shipping, oil tanker operations, bulk carrier services, and roll-on/roll-off (Ro-Ro) shipping. The company utilizes a diverse fleet for these activities, including crude oil tankers, dry bulk vessels, Ro-Ro ships, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers. Established in 2004, the firm is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
